rules.question: Strikes per Flicker Strike use at c Power Charges.
rules.rule: H(c) = 1 + 2c, c = Power Charges held at use (removable charges).

rules.question: Can Power Charges be gained while Flicker Strike is in use?
rules.rule: No. Charges gained by Whirling Assault arrive before the Flicker Strike use starts.

rules.question: Elapsed time of one Flicker Strike use with H strikes.
rules.rule: Proposed: H(c) / S_F seconds, strikes evenly spaced at 1 / S_F; S_F is PoB Speed (strikes per second). Unvalidated: no evidence on teleport travel time.

rules.question: Is Flicker Strike's mana cost paid once per use or once per strike?
rules.rule: Unresolved. The skill text describes one use with additional strikes, which reads as one payment; PoB's ManaPerSecondCost multiplies the per-use cost by the strike rate, which reads as one payment per strike.

rules.question: How many consumed Power Charges stay after a Flicker Strike use?
rules.rule: Each consumed charge independently stays with probability q = 0.25 and still counts as consumed (Flicker Strike's extra strikes and 'consumed recently' effects use the full count). Carry = Binomial(c, 0.25). Applies to Flicker Strike only: Perpetual Charge is socketed in its group, not with Charged Staff.

rules.question: Power Charges gained when Whirling Assault expends K Combo.
rules.rule: Surpassing chance P = 25% x K. Gain floor(P / 100) charges, plus one more with probability (P mod 100) / 100, then cap at maximum Power Charges. At K = 10: 2 charges, plus a third with probability 0.5.
rules.limitation: The Surpassing definition comes from a search summary of the community wiki, which refused automated access. A reviewer may require the page itself or an in-game tooltip capture.

rules.question: Combo the Culmination-supported Whirling Assault gains from one Flicker Strike use.
rules.rule: Unresolved. Culmination II: Combo is gained when you successfully Strike with other Melee Attacks; Martial Adept: one additional Combo when Combo is gained. Whether each teleporting strike is a separate gain event, or the use is one, is not established.

alternatives.consequence: 10 Combo at every use with c >= 2; at c = 0 a use gives 2 Combo.
Whirling Assault expends at most 2 Combo (plus its own hits, see whirling-assault-own-combo): 50% chance of 1 charge per cycle.

rules.conflict: The owner's rotation reads 'whirling assault to get 5 power charges'. Under per_strike, one Whirling Assault expending 10 Combo gives 2 or 3 charges; 5 needs carried charges from Perpetual Charge. Under per_use, far fewer. Neither alternative explains 5 from one Whirling Assault use, so at least one rule here differs from the game or the statement describes a typical, not a guaranteed, state.

rules.question: Does Whirling Assault gain Combo from its own hits?
rules.rule: Unresolved. Culmination II grants Combo for strikes with other Melee Attacks; Martial Master grants Combo from all Attack Hits. Which wins for the supported skill itself, and how many hits one Whirling Assault use performs (PoB gives damage per use, not a hit count), is not established.

rules.question: Combo cap and decay for the supported Whirling Assault.
rules.rule: Cap 10 on the stored count; all Combo is expended on use; decay starts 6.0 s after the last gain. A cycle that waits (for mana, Hit and Run or Charged Staff) longer than 6.0 s after the last Flicker strike loses its Combo.

rules.question: Whirling Assault time and mana per use.
rules.rule: t_WA = PoB Time with group 8 as main skill; mana per use = PoB ManaCost.

rules.question: Charged Staff time, mana and charge use per press.
rules.rule: One press takes PoB Time, costs PoB ManaCost, needs at least 1 Power Charge and consumes all held charges (s = charges held). Perpetual Charge does not apply (not in its group).

rules.question: How much added lightning the Charged Staff buff gives Flicker Strike's strikes, and for how long.
rules.rule: Proposed: the buff's stacks equal the charges Charged Staff consumed at its press (s), independent of the charges Flicker Strike later consumes; it lasts 6 s per stack. A Flicker strike under a buff of s stacks deals per-strike damage A_CS(s) = PoB AverageDamage at s forced charges with Charged Staff enabled; with no buff, A_0 = the Charged Staff disabled value. PoB itself reads both from the current charge count, so its AverageBurstDamage with Charged Staff enabled is not used directly.
open: Refresh rule: 'Reusing this skill while the Buff is active adds to the Buff's duration and damage' gives no cap or formula.
Press period N (owner Q10 answer: once per N cycles; N not yet given) -> gap-p09-t012-charged-staff-period.

A_CS(s) also includes the 'consumed a Power Charge recently' effects, which PoB ties to the same charge count; for a strike with 0 charges consumed recently this mixes two states (pob/consumed-recently-parse).

rules.question: When do the seed's three 'if you've consumed a Power Charge Recently' passives apply?
rules.rule: PoB applies them whenever the current skill has a removable charge (pob/consumed-recently-parse), i.e. at c >= 1. Proposed for the cycle: they apply to a strike when any Power Charge was consumed in the previous 4 s (by Flicker Strike or Charged Staff); the A values with and without them are both captured. 'Recently' = 4 s is the game's general definition and is not in the pinned data.

rules.question: Is Flicker Strike usable again after each use, and at what speed?
rules.rule: Unresolved. The supported skill becomes usable after moving 10 metres and unusable again after use. Nothing pinned or retrieved says whether Flicker Strike's teleport, or Whirling Assault's advance, counts as moving. Owner statement (Q5) only.

alternatives.basis: the support removed: no activation condition, no 40% more skill speed
alternatives.note: A different build from the seed; evaluated as a labelled variant.

alternatives.basis: an explicit 10 m movement action before each Flicker Strike use
alternatives.missing: movement speed in metres per second for the seed; PoB has no metre-based movement output (gap-p09-t011-spatial-unit)

rules.question: Does the benchmark keep Pounce's Predator's Mark?
rules.rule: No. PoB applies the mark as 3% increased damage taken per minion in presence and counts Whirling Assault's eight Living Lightning minions, giving the enemy 24% increased damage taken. Owner Q4 keeps Pounce out of the rotation, and the mark needs a Pounce use the benchmark does not schedule. Benchmark documents disable Pounce (group 4); Flicker Strike per-strike damage falls by the factor 1 / 1.24.

rules.question: Which buff states feeding Flicker Strike are legitimate at t = 0?
rules.rule: Herald of Ice and Herald of Thunder (their 'affected by a Herald' passives), Wind Dancer, Ghost Dance, Trinity, Remnants of Kalguur are persistent Spirit skills (owner Q4) and stay. Disabling them one at a time changes Flicker Strike damage only for the two heralds. Full Life holds: Chaos Inoculation sets maximum life to 1 and the benchmark has no incoming damage.

rules.question: Which PoB defaults raise Flicker Strike damage without the rotation generating them?
rules.rule: After the Pounce change, none found among conditional modifiers and enemy modifiers. Rage is 0, Onslaught off, Shock off, Trinity resonance 0, Combo not used by Flicker Strike: these understate damage the build may generate and are not counted. Mageblood's 42% increased Speed is an item modifier PoB applies without a condition; it stays as PoB's model under the D07 amendment. The imported config inputs (inDemonForm, touchedDebuffsCount, purpleFlameStacks, targetBrandedEnemy, SecondsSinceInevitableCrit, companionInPresence and similar) feed no Flicker Strike modifier on this build.

rules.question: Mana available over the 120 s window.
rules.rule: Pool, regeneration and the mana flask are now known from PoB; the flask policy is not. On a single non-dying target no kill-based flask charges or mana on kill apply.
open: Flask charges at t = 0 (the initial-state proposal fixes energy shield and mana, not flask charges).
When the flask is used (owner Q6: on bosses) and whether a use is a timed action.
Per-use or per-strike Flicker Strike mana (gap-p09-t012-flicker-mana-charging).
rules.implication: At 5 charges one Whirling Assault plus one Flicker Strike costs 408 mana per cycle (per-use charging) against 47.9 mana per second of regeneration; the pool and flask cover only part of 120 s, so a supported score must include waiting for mana.

rules.question: How often Charged Staff is pressed.
rules.rule: Owner Q10: once per N cycles; owner decision 2026-10-18 (2): Whirling Assault, Charged Staff, then Whirling Assault and Flicker Strike until the buff expires, repeated. The period follows from the buff duration: 6 s per stack (ChargedStaffBuffDuration) x (1 + 25% increased duration on the seed) x stacks consumed. Each press costs its own time and mana.

rules.question: Does PoB's default 'Bypass CD?' for Flicker Strike change the seed's numbers?
rules.rule: No. The import does not write FlickerStrikeBypassCD; PoB defaults it on and adds CooldownRecovery OVERRIDE 0 for Flicker Strike. The pinned Flicker Strike has no cooldown, and switching the option off leaves every captured output unchanged. The benchmark may leave it at the default.

rules.question: Distance between the character and the target for Close Combat II.
rules.rule: PoB uses its placeholder enemyDistance 20 (2 m) when the document sets none; Close Combat II gives 30% more damage at 1 m or less, falling to 0 at 3.5 m, so 18% at 2 m. Flicker Strike teleports to its target, but the resulting distance is not established. Proposed: keep the placeholder (the value the seed was imported with) and report the sensitivity.

rules.question: PoB leaves Way of the Stonefist unparsed. Does the seed lose its effect?
rules.rule: Not for the base type: the imported gloves already are 'Runeforged Fists of Stone', so the account API returned the transformed item. Whether their explicit modifiers are the transformed, stronger versions is not established; PoB evaluates the text as imported. Martial Adept and Martial Master are also unparsed by PoB; their Combo effects belong to the cycle rules (combo-gain-per-strike, whirling-assault-own-combo), not to PoB damage.
